I hope every journalist in America embraces the Nick Shirley era and starts knocking on doors to just ask the simple questions.

This is SHOCKING.


Luke Rosiak (@lukerosiak)

You've heard about this story. Now you get to see it.

I traveled to Columbus, Ohio, and witnessed the most egregious government waste I've seen in my 20 years as an investigative reporter.

This has been going on for years, and you've been paying for it.

Take a look⬇️

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/lukerosiak/status
Add to this thread your favorite Americana-themed kids books so I can add them to the collection! 🫶🇺🇸

While filling in for @PressSec, @marcorubio answers a powerful question: "What is your hope for America at a time such as this?"

His answer blew me away.

Video

Between 2020 and 2024, young female voters shifted 11 points away from the Democrat Party and toward the Republican Party. In one election cycle.

Don't despair and discount young women just yet.


Brittany Hugoboom (@BritHugoboom)

People are using this chart to say that “women are becoming more liberal.” 

However, it’s worth noticing the significant drop post 2020.





— https://nitter.net/BritHugoboom/status/2051720436501615042#m

Please pray for an end to violence in our country.


BNO News (@BNONews)

UPDATE: 1 person shot by law enforcement near the White House. Circumstances still unclear.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/BNONews/status/2051396658643001763#m

I’m sorry…. $66 MILLION??!!?

How much of this is happening in our country right in front of our faces??


Luke Rosiak (@lukerosiak)

94 Medicaid "home health" companies purport to occupy this office building, taking more than $66 million of your money. They provide free butlers to immigrants.

"No windows on the outside hides the fact that there's no one on the inside." There's an entire street of these.





— https://nitter.net/lukerosiak/status/2051306293814608092#m

And only about 175 million of those streams were from me :)


chart data (@chartdata)

Billboard 200: #1(new) @NoahKahan, The Great Divide 389,000 [215.37 million on-demand streams | 175,000 pure sales].



— https://nitter.net/chartdata/status/2051014213254967777#m

The back of her shirt *literally* says “do unto others as you would have them do unto you.”

The proclivity for violence toward conservatives in our society is completely off the rails.


End Wokeness (@EndWokeness)

She's wearing shirt about "kindness" as she does this. You can't make it up.

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/EndWokeness/status/2050658834482610581#m

To the contrary - while abortion intentionally takes the life of an innocent person, chemo, insulin, and C-sections attempt to save someone’s life in the face of illness or injury.


isha (@MibshaD)

If abortion is "playing God," so is chemo, insulin, and C-sections. Funny how only women's medical choices get called sacrilegious.



— https://nitter.net/MibshaD/status/2050770484321755142#m

& just like that our little girl is One Big Beautiful Baby!!

Grateful beyond words for Isla lighting up our lives this year - you are everything to us, sweet girl! 🫶 what a weekend celebrating with our friends & family who’ve supported us in immeasurable ways this first year as parents… we love you guys!

Imagine if this man actually fabricated "I bet your fish head wife doesn't have these cannons" as an insult against YOUR OWN WIFE in a made up sexual harassment suit 🤡

Do you think the JP Morgan lawsuit is fabricated??

Video

This is the most wholesome thing I've ever seen


CatholicVote (@CatholicVote)

This is incredible.

A 10-year-old boy shares that he wants to be a priest when he grows up, citing a call God has put on his heart:

"Why have you decided you want to be a priest?"

"Because God's calling me."

Beautiful 🥹

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/CatholicVote/status/2049492752937763125#m

Hoping this can help you:

• none of us have a constitutional right to murder another human being
• you can still take out student loans!!
• the U.S. is in the top 3rd of countries worldwide with clean air, & top 25 for clean drinking water
• RFK has actually moved for a re-examination of GRAS standards to remove harmful chemicals from food!!
• you still have a Congressman in your district representing you that you can vote for!!

Do people actually believe this stuff?


g. (@GeauxGabrielle)

In

This is a beautiful reflection on the status of our country's soul and why Charlie's voice was so important.

Thank you for your voice, E.


Erika Kirk (@MrsErikaKirk)



Video
  





— https://nitter.net/MrsErikaKirk/status/2049534498514383108#m

A shockingly well-written piece by @usweekly on my recent appearance with @madiprew on her Stay True Podcast... though I'd hardly call myself "Charlie's protegee" (truth is, there are dozens of us who were privileged to call Charlie a mentor).

Still learning how to navigate the personal grief of losing my friend, but also the societal hole his assassination has left behind.

Charlie was undoubtedly the leader of the conservative movement, but he also was a deeply needed moral leader for our gen

There are a million things wrong with this picture. But perhaps chief among them is the sheer mockery of the grit and strength it takes women to bring new life into the world from a depraved man.

Exactly a year ago tonight, I was packing up & heading to  labor and delivery to give birth to my beautiful daughter.

Childbirth was nothing short of miraculous - as any mom will tell you, the veil between heaven and earth is so thin during those precious moments. It was easily among the best days of

This is objectively terrifying.


Tanning Salon Don (@TheSalonDon)

OBGYN just told my wife to go on SSRIs during pregnancy

I asked if there’s studies she can show to make us comfortable 

She said she doesn’t sit around reading medical literature but 70% of her patients are on them while pregnant

We have a health crisis in America



— https://nitter.net/TheSalonDon/status/2049187246973018305#m
Hey so maybe just read a book!!#greenscreen
Bring back eyebrow furrows por favor
Being pregnant is not a death sentence - it’s one of the best things that could ever happen in your life as a a woman. Full interview dropping Friday 🫶
Literally what is the Senate doing atp

maybe slowing down is the whole point. even though you all warned me that “the days are long, but the years are short,” this first year with my baby girl evaporated in the blink of an eye… what I wouldn’t give for one more newborn snuggle, hearing her laugh like this for the first time, seeing the light in her eyes as she takes her first steps, and her needing to hold my hand for just a little bit longer. there is truly nothing more beautiful in my life than being your mama, sweet girl 🤍
The sweetest weekend showering our ONE YEAR OLD with so much love from her friends and family 🤍 we love being your Mom & Dad, Isla girl!!
… the woman was too stunned to speak
Do you guys think this is real?? 🧐🧐🧐
We shouldn’t romanticize killing babies for political gain.
I can’t believe it’s already been a year since I gave birth 😭
